answer_1.quote: We experiment with a variety of language tasks to evaluate the influence of parallel context encoding, including LM, ICL, RAG and synthetic recall tasks.
datasets: HELMET benchmark (TREC-coarse, TREC-fine, BANKING77, CLINC150, NLU for ICL; Natural Question, TriviaQA, HotpotQA, PopQA for RAG; RULER, JSON retrieval for synthetic recall)
answer_1.outputs: Generated text outputs for evaluation in language modeling, in-context learning, retrieval-augmented generation, and synthetic recall tasks.

answer_2.quote: measure the perplexity (PPL) of the query tokens for LM. For other tasks, we follow HELMET and measure substring exact match for RAG and synthetic recall, and accuracy for ICL
